variants.headline: The colony has voted
variants.sub: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}. The event places representation at the centre of public attention. The assessment of {target} should distinguish the holding of an election from any claim about what its result authorises.

The gazette records the holding of the election without attributing a particular intention to the electorate. The act of voting and the subsequent exercise of public authority are distinct matters. An orderly account should preserve the difference between an electoral event and the interpretation placed upon it.

We regard {target} favourably in this assessment. Participation in representative politics deserves a fair hearing, and an election should be an occasion for reasoned judgment rather than reflexive hostility. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.headline: Ballots before the business of government
variants.sub: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place.
variants.body:
